meta: Getting lost or losing your passport abroad is not the time to start worrying: ask AI to help you prepare before the trip.

muc.title: A lost passport in a strange place
muc.text: Getting lost or losing your passport abroad is not the time to start worrying. Ask AI to help you prepare before the trip.

muc.title: The phrases you need most
muc.text: Ask AI for phrases in the local language for being lost, needing a doctor or losing your passport, with pronunciation.

muc.title: An emergency list
muc.text: Ask AI for an emergency list: a copy of your passport, your insurance number, your hotel address and the steps to take if documents are lost.

muc.title: Embassy numbers
muc.text: Look up embassy numbers on the official site yourself, because AI can be wrong, and never paste your passport number into AI.

muc.title: Five emergency phrases
muc.text: Ask AI for five emergency phrases in the language of your next destination, and save them in your notes.
